writing.overall_comment: This is a strong, focused Go development skill with clear architecture guidance and idiomatic examples, but it relies on external references and leaves some code fragments partial.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately frame the skill's Fiber, Cobra, GORM, Clean Architecture, and concurrency focus, matching the document content.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The examples are idiomatic and cover several failure paths such as error swallowing, N+1 queries, and goroutine leaks, though some snippets omit imports or full dependency context.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The document gives explicit structures, response workflows, and best practices, but many executable templates are deferred to external references rather than embedded directly.

suggestions: In the Examples & edge cases section, add the missing import statements to every Go snippet that currently lacks them so the examples compile independently.

In the same Examples & edge cases section, add the minimal surrounding dependency context—such as type definitions, DB/client setup, or goroutine coordination—for each failure-path snippet so readers can reproduce the error swallowing, N+1, and goroutine leak scenarios.
For snippets where imports or dependency context are intentionally omitted for brevity, add a one-line note listing the omitted prerequisites so readers understand what is assumed.
